nodes.title: Define API contract and hand-off documentation for tool suggestions
nodes.summary: Before any UI work is finalized, specify the new backend endpoints the feature needs: submit a tool suggestion (authenticated user, free-text description), and list, view and update the status of suggestions for admin users. Document request and response schemas, validation rules (required description, length limits), auth and role requirements, error responses, and the data model (id, description, submitter, created timestamp, status). Package this as a standalone document the API Agent can act on, and include mock or stub response shapes so the frontend can be built in parallel.

nodes.title: Add Context Menu component to the top Global Nav
nodes.summary: Build a reusable context menu control positioned at the leftmost point of the viewport within the Global Nav's context. Handle open and close behavior, keyboard accessibility, focus management, click-outside dismissal, and responsive layout, and make sure it does not disturb existing nav items. Initially it contains a single option (e.g. 'Suggest a tool') that triggers the suggestion modal, and the item structure should make future options easy to add.

nodes.title: Build the Tool Suggestion modal and submission flow
nodes.summary: Implement the modal opened from the context menu option, with a text area for the description of the new tool suggestion. Include client-side validation, submit and cancel actions, loading, success and error states, and accessible modal behavior (focus trap, Escape to close). Wire submission to the new suggestion endpoint through an API client layer, using the documented contract and a mock adapter until the backend is ready. Cover the flow with component and integration tests.

{"planState":"tasks_created","planPromptText":"Goal: Build the Tool Suggestion modal and submission flow
Description: Implement the modal opened from the context menu option, with a text area for the description of the new tool suggestion. Include client-side validation, submit and cancel actions, loading, success and error states, and accessible modal behavior (focus trap, Escape to close). Wire submission to the new suggestion endpoint through an API client layer, using the documented contract and a mock adapter until the backend is ready. Cover the flow with component and integration tests.

nodes.title: Admin view for reviewing submitted tool suggestions
nodes.summary: Provide an admin-only view where suggestions saved by users can be listed, opened and processed further. Show the description, submitter and date, support basic status handling (e.g. new, reviewed, accepted, rejected) as defined in the API contract, and enforce role-based access so non-admin users cannot see the view or its navigation entry. Include empty, loading and error states and tests for the permission checks.

nodes.title: Integration, QA and release readiness for the suggestion feature
nodes.summary: Once the API Agent has delivered the endpoints, replace mocks with the real API and verify the end-to-end flow from menu to modal to saved suggestion to admin visibility. Check edge cases (empty or very long input, network failures, unauthorized access), cross-browser and mobile behavior of the nav menu, and accessibility. Finalize developer documentation and update any project README or changelog.
